changes: Fixed: Hold'em's Stand Up and Sit Out buttons could silently do nothing on tap — the table view re-renders on every realtime update from the table (anyone's seat, not just yours), and used to unconditionally rebuild the whole actions area every time, which can yank the exact button a finger is mid-tap on out from under it. Now only rebuilds when what's shown actually needs to change.

New: Lifetime XP now shown as its own line under the balance on the Casino leaderboard (never goes down, so it reads as true all-time standing even after a rough run), and added as its own stat on member profile cards in the Board tab leaderboard.

Craps — full polish pass: dice are now a genuine 3D cube (real front/back/left/right/top/bottom faces in true 3D space, not a flat pip-grid pretending to spin) with correct geometry so the tumble always settles square-on. Bet amounts now show as proper casino chip tokens (solid gold for a bet already riding, dashed ghost chip for this round's not-yet-rolled stake) instead of plain text. Tapping a ghost chip now removes just that one bet. Fixed a real race condition where a fast double-tap on Roll could let two rolls run at once and corrupt/strand bet state (the reported 'can't place multiple bets, only one clears' and 'Clear button not working' bugs) — Roll and Clear New Bets are now hard-locked against overlapping taps. Clear New Bets also gives a visible gold flash confirming it worked.

New: Craps added to the Games list as a full high-roller table, same visual polish level as Roulette — Pass Line, Don't Pass, Come, Don't Come, Field, Odds behind Pass/Don't Pass (true odds, no house edge), Place bets (4/5/6/8/9/10), Hardways (4/6/8/10), and one-roll Props (Any 7, Any Craps, 2, 3, 11, 12), plus a recent-rolls history strip and its own felt table with a brass rail bezel and MLSYND CASINO watermark, matching Roulette's treatment.

New: pressing Spin (Roulette) or Roll (Craps) now smoothly scrolls the wheel/dice into view first, so the animation is actually visible even if you tapped the button from further down the page on a small phone screen.

Fixed: Hold'em and Challenges were sharing icons with Craps (dice) and Casino War (crossed swords) after moving into the Games grid. Hold'em now has its own custom poker chip icon; Challenges now uses boxing gloves — every game tile has a distinct image.

Moved: Challenges and Hold'em are no longer their own tiles on the Casino landing hub — they now live inside Games, alongside Blackjack/Roulette/Craps/etc, as regular game bubbles (badges for pending challenges/active hands still show). The landing hub is back down to Games/Rules/Earning XP/Badges.

Fixed: a real Hold'em bug where the hand's own winner could see 'Spectating — no cards this hand' in Your Cards at showdown, even though seats/spectators could already see their revealed cards. Your Cards now uses the same revealed-card data as the seats at showdown instead of a secret fetch that's no longer available by then.

New: Hold'em showdown result is now a proper banner (glow effect, gold/green highlight, trophy on your own win) with mini playing cards shown next to the winning hand, not just a rank name. Recent Hands now shows the same mini cards for showdown wins.
New: the Hold'em table's watermark is now the actual MLSYND CASINO wordmark; the Big Blind info moved to a small bubble near the bottom of the table instead of sitting in the center.
Polish: Hold'em's in-table chat now shows proper message bubbles (yours align right), a labelled header, and a nicer empty state, on both the table and hand-in-progress views.

Tipping: Rounds 0, 5, 25-29 now show their real names (Opening Round, Gather Round, Wildcard Finals, Qualifying/Elimination Round, Semi Finals, Preliminary Finals, Grand Final) everywhere a round is shown, not just 'Round N'.

Casino: the live-win flash ticker threshold raised from 300 to 500 XP. Baccarat's Banker bet no longer takes a 5% commission — it now pays 1:1, same as Player. Big Win popups now show a visual of the actual hand (Baccarat/Casino War/Craps) or winning number (Roulette) when available.
Fixed: Home tab's individual bet amount now colors strictly by Win/Loss result, not just the sign of the dollar figure — a $0.00 loss now shows red instead of green.
